svg.title: Stereo-PIV: Stereo calibration
svg.desc: PIVlab finds the board corners in both images, computes where the cameras are and maps both onto one common grid: a point of the sheet is at the same pixel in both cameras. Drawing: PIVlab, www.pivlab.de, CC BY 4.0.
svg.text: common grid in the light sheet (both cameras)
PIVlab finds the board corners in both images, computes where the cameras are and maps both
onto one common grid: a point of the sheet is at the same pixel in both cameras.
